functions.signature: private.data_export_snapshot(uuid, uuid, jsonb, timestamp with time zone)
public.rpc_taxonomy_capture_gemini_turn_hints_service(uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, uuid, text, bigint, jsonb)

constraints.name: taxonomy_confirmed_worker_mod_worker_account_id_category_i_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (worker_account_id, category_id) REFERENCES private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities(worker_account_id, category_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: taxonomy_confirmed_worker_mode_category_id_execution_scope_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (category_id, execution_scope) REFERENCES private.work_taxonomy_category_modes(category_id, execution_scope) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: work_taxonomy_admissions_v1_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'PENDING'::text) AND (approved_at IS NULL) AND (committed_at IS NULL) AND (result IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'APPROVED'::text) AND (approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (committed_at IS NULL) AND (result IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'COMMITTED'::text) AND (approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (committed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (result IS NOT NULL))))

triggers: CREATE TRIGGER taxonomy_signed_need_bound_requeue_v1 AFTER INSERT ON private.work_taxonomy_need_bindings_v1 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_signed_binding_requeue_v1()

constraints.name: work_taxonomy_need_skills_need_id_need_revision_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (need_id, need_revision) REFERENCES private.work_taxonomy_need_snapshots(need_id, need_revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: work_taxonomy_need_snapshots_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((classification_state <> 'CONFIRMED'::text) OR ((category_id IS NOT NULL) AND reviewed_by_requester)))

constraints.name: work_taxonomy_need_snapshots_need_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (need_id) REFERENCES public.needs(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: work_taxonomy_review_outbox_v1_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((state = 'CLAIMED'::text) AND (lease_token IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_until IS NOT NULL)) OR ((state <> 'CLAIMED'::text) AND (lease_token IS NULL) AND (lease_until IS NULL))))

triggers: CREATE TRIGGER taxonomy_signed_worker_bound_requeue_v1 AFTER INSERT ON private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_signed_binding_requeue_v1()

constraints.name: valid_worker_execution_modes
constraints.definition: CHECK (((modes = ARRAY['ON_SITE'::text]) OR (modes = ARRAY['REMOTE'::text]) OR (modes = ARRAY['ON_SITE'::text, 'REMOTE'::text])))

constraints.name: worker_execution_mode_choices_worker_account_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (worker_account_id) REFERENCES public.app_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: worker_execution_mode_choices_worker_profile_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (worker_profile_id) REFERENCES public.app_profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
